single_request_duplication_adjudication.reason: The proven substitution changes 16 bytes inside one existing 197-byte carrier and preserves its length. Duplicating that frame would insert 197 stream bytes, shift subsequent TCP sequence space, reuse game-owned request/session/authentication identities, consume an RPC call ID and FrameUp sequence unknown to the game, and leave the game transport without matching pending-call state.

carrier_count.same_marker_reason: Cross-marker slot/skill substitution preserves the carrier skill UUID, but no evidence proves that the server does not bind that UUID to the original slot or skill. Production planning therefore changes XYZ only and requires carrier marker N for saved marker N.
